lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਾਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: preetam jaan lehu man maahee ||
lines.translation: O dear friend, know this in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਹੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਂਧਿਓ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: apane sukh siu hee jag phaa(n)dhio ko kaahoo ko naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The world is entangled in its own pleasures; no one is for anyone else. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਮੈ ਆਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਰਹਤ ਚਹੂ ਦਿਸਿ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh mai aan bahut mil baithat rahat chahoo dis gherai ||
lines.translation: In good times, many come and sit together, surrounding you on all four sides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪਰੀ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿਤ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bipat paree sabh hee sa(n)g chhaadit kooo na aavat nerai ||1||
lines.translation: But when hard times come, they all leave, and no one comes near you. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਤ ਸੰਗ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar kee naar bahut hit jaa siu sadaa rahat sa(n)g laagee ||
lines.translation: Your wife, whom you love so much, and who has remained ever attached to you,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੰਸ ਤਜੀ ਇਹ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jab hee ha(n)s tajee ih kaa(n)iaa pret pret kar bhaagee ||2||
lines.translation: runs away crying, "Ghost! Ghost!", as soon as the swan-soul leaves this body. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih bidh ko biuhaar banio hai jaa siu nehu lagaaio ||
lines.translation: This is the way they act - those whom we love so much.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋਊ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t baar naanak bin har jee kooo kaam na aaio ||3||12||139||
lines.translation: At the very last moment, O Nanak, no one is any use at all, except the Dear Lord. ||3||12||139||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਚਉਤੁਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ghar 1 asatapadeeaa chautukee ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa, Chau-Thukay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਪੜਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਉ ਮੜੈ ਮਸਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dubidhaa na paRau har bin hor na poojau maRai masaan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: I am not torn by duality, because I do not worship any other than the Lord; I do not visit tombs or crematoriums.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਨ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa raach na par ghar jaavaa trisanaa naam bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: I do not enter the houses of strangers, engrossed in desire. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has satisfied my desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar bheetar ghar guroo dikhaaiaa sahaj rate man bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Deep within my heart, the Guru has shown me the home of my being, and my mind is imbued with peace and poise, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too aape daanaa aape beenaa too devahi mat saaee ||1||
lines.translation: You Yourself are all-knowing, and You Yourself are all-seeing; You alone bestow intelligence, O Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ਰਤਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bairaag ratau bairaagee sabad man bedhiaa meree maaee ||
lines.translation: My mind is detached, imbued with detachment; the Word of the Shabad has pierced my mind, O my mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar jot nira(n)tar baanee saache saahib siu liv laaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: God's Light shines continually within the nucleus of my deepest self; I am lovingly attached to the Bani, the Word of the True Lord Master. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸੰਖ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: asa(n)kh bairaagee kahahi bairaag so bairaagee j khasamai bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Countless detached renunciates talk of detachment and renunciation, but he alone is a true renunciate, who is pleasing to the Lord Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਭੈ ਰਚਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai sabad sadaa bhai rachiaa gur kee kaar kamaavai ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Shabad is ever in his heart; he is absorbed in the Fear of God, and he works to serve the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko chetai manooaa na dolai dhaavat varaj rahaavai ||
lines.translation: He remembers the One Lord, his mind does not waver, and he restrains its wanderings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje maataa sadaa ra(n)g raataa saache ke gun gaavai ||2||
lines.translation: He is intoxicated with celestial bliss, and is ever imbued with the Lord's Love; he sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਪਉਣੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manooaa paun bi(n)d sukhavaasee naam vasai sukh bhaaee ||
lines.translation: The mind is like the wind, but if it comes to rest in peace, even for an instant, then he shall abide in the peace of the Name, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਤ੍ਰ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਲਿ ਬੂਝੀ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jihabaa netr sotr sach raate jal boojhee tujhahi bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: His tongue, eyes and ears are imbued with Truth; O Lord, You quench the fires of desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aas niraas rahai bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laaee ||
lines.translation: In hope, the renunciate remains free of hopes; in the home of his own inner self, he is absorbed in the trance of deep meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਜੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhikhiaa naam raje sa(n)tokhee a(n)mrit sahaj peeaaee ||3||
lines.translation: He remains content, satisfied with the charity of the Naam; he drinks in the Ambrosial Amrit with ease. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dubidhaa vich bairaag na hovee jab lag doojee raaee ||
lines.translation: There is no renunciation in duality, as long as there is even a particle of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag teraa too eko daataa avar na doojaa bhaaee ||
lines.translation: The whole world is Yours, Lord; You alone are the Giver. There is not any other, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੰਤ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh ja(n)t dukh sadaa nivaasee guramukh de vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh dwells in misery forever, while the Lord bestows greatness upon the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਹਣੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: apar apaar aga(n)m agochar kahanai keem na paaee ||4||
lines.translation: God is infinite, endless, inaccessible and unfathomable; His worth cannot be described. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)n samaadh mahaa paramaarath teen bhavan pat naama(n) ||
lines.translation: The consciousness in deep Samaadhi, the Supreme Being, the Lord of the three worlds - these are Your Names, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਸਹਾਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: masatak lekh jeeaa jag jonee sir sir lekh sahaama(n) ||
lines.translation: The creatures born into this world have their destiny inscribed upon their foreheads; they experience according to their destinies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam sukaram karaae aape aape bhagat driRaama(n) ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself causes them to do good and bad deeds; He Himself makes them steadfast in devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੂਠਿ ਲਹੈ ਭੈ ਮਾਨੰ ਆਪੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਗਾਮੰ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: man mukh jooth lahai bhai maana(n) aape giaan agaama(n) ||5||
lines.translation: The filth of their mind and mouth is washed off when they live in the Fear of God; the inaccessible Lord Himself blesses them with spiritual wisdom. ||5||
